name: credit-risk-portfolio-dashboard
description: Tablero web de analítica de cartera de crédito (EL = PD x LGD x EAD, matrices de transición de Markov) con datos sintéticos reproducibles.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @credit-risk/core && npm run build -w credit-risk-api && npm run build -w credit-risk-dashboard-web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @credit-risk/core && npm run build -w credit-risk-dashboard-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @credit-risk/core && npm run test -w credit-risk-dashboard-web
